title: Services landing page
summary: A service provider's landing page with navigation, applications presented in tabs, and frequently asked questions.
scope: The request calls for HTML. An order form is mentioned but not supplied.
possible_checks: Inspect page structure, headings, link names, and readable contrast.
Exercise the tabbed content with a keyboard and inspect its names and state.
Record the behavior of the requested order-form action.

title: Consulting landing page
summary: A consulting page with responsive design, animated elements, and a named web stack.
scope: The original request explicitly mentions accessible contrast and semantic HTML.
possible_checks: Inspect contrast, headings, landmarks, and the names of interactive controls.
Review navigation and calls to action using a keyboard.
Review motion and content visibility, including a reduced-motion setting.

title: Cinema booking
summary: Film listings with screening options, showtimes, and a ticket-selection journey.
scope: The request includes ticket confirmation and regional choices; film data is not supplied.
possible_checks: Check film discovery and screening selection before judging accessibility.
Review labels, keyboard use, focus, and the state of selection controls.
Inspect any required feedback or confirmation that the site provides.

title: Task dashboard
summary: A task management dashboard with a board, filters, charts, and editing actions.
scope: The request has a broad feature set and names several libraries.
possible_checks: Check task creation, editing, and filtering before judging accessibility.
Review keyboard operation and non-dragging alternatives where needed.
Inspect chart alternatives and the names and states of controls.

title: Personal portfolio
summary: A personal portfolio with a featured project, project navigation, and an about section.
scope: This short request leaves most implementation details to the model.
possible_checks: Review heading hierarchy, landmarks, reading order, and link names.
Navigate the site with a keyboard and inspect visible focus.
Review alternatives for informative images if images are included.
